fields.mechanism: Adsorption of arsenic by magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles embedded in a porous cellulose matrix.
fields.intervention: Replace the standard filter media in the rural water filter with pulverized eggshells and magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles enclosed within a Bemliese teabag to serve as the primary filtration cartridge.
fields.expected_effect: Passive removal of arsenic from groundwater to below WHO limits without requiring electricity or added chemical reagents during operation.
fields.falsification_test: Pass groundwater containing 50 μg/L arsenic through the modified filter at a flow rate of 1 L/hour and measure effluent concentration; failure occurs if effluent exceeds 10 μg/L.
